address: chaussée du Roi Baudouin 117, Saint-Symphorien, 7030, Belgium
bio: Stéphane Grulois is a man of many talents and the stylish, cosy interior of this arty restaurant is also his work. He is, however, first and foremost a gifted chef. His love of French cuisine shines through the distinctive flavours of his inspired recipes, to which he enjoys adding a new spin and also inviting fine Belgian delicacies....
